summary: Worked as a full-stack developer in a small, fully remote startup, independently designing and implementing production features involving expert matching, product relevance scoring, data validation and analytics.

context.company: A European wine marketplace connecting customers directly with wine producers, without maintaining its own inventory or warehouses. The platform also aimed to build a community around wine reviews, tastings and expert advice.
context.product: An e-commerce and community platform serving consumers, restaurants and wine experts.
context.team: Six developers, including four interns and two more experienced developers who had previously joined as interns.
context.environment: Fully remote startup with considerable individual responsibility and frequent production releases.

contributions.name: Wine Expert Matching
contributions.problem: Wine advice requests were originally routed to a single in-house expert. The platform needed a scalable solution for distributing requests among registered experts based on their availability and areas of expertise.
contributions.solution: Designed and implemented a permanent, rule-based matching system that selected suitable wine experts based on availability and country-specific expertise.
implementation: Extracted preferred wine countries from submitted customer request forms.
Retrieved registered, active experts whose open_to_help_user setting was true.
Compared requested countries against each expert's areas of expertise.
Assigned one matching point per country.
Ranked experts according to their matching scores.
Randomly selected an expert when multiple candidates shared the highest qualifying score.
Implemented a fallback to an in-house account when no suitable expert was found.
contributions.extensibility: Designed the matching approach to accommodate additional criteria in the future, such as food-pairing expertise and other expert qualifications.
contributions.ownership: Responsible for designing and implementing the feature end-to-end, discussing relevant technical decisions with the CTO and other team members when appropriate.

contributions.name: Product Relevance Scoring
contributions.problem: The platform needed a meaningful and maintainable way to determine which products should appear most prominently across listings and highlighted sections.
contributions.solution: Designed and implemented a rule-based relevance scoring algorithm combining weighted product signals into a sortable score, with automated weekly recalculation.
implementation: Explored signals such as product reviews, sales and recency.
Assigned different weights to signals based on their intended importance.
Weighted expert reviews four times more heavily than regular user reviews.
Introduced a temporary cold-start boost for newly added products during an initial eligibility period.
Implemented time-based decay affecting the total calculated relevance score.
Calculated and stored product relevance scores to support sorting.
Implemented a Google Cloud Scheduler job to update relevance scores for all products weekly.
contributions.extensibility: Designed the scoring approach to allow additional product signals and parameters to be incorporated over time.
contributions.ownership: Took a loosely defined feature request from concept to production implementation, consulting the CTO and other developers on meaningful technical and architectural decisions.
verificationNeeded: Confirm whether the mathematical scoring approach was based on a Bayesian model.
Confirm the exact formula and decay behavior before documenting mathematical details.

contributions.name: Product Analytics Integration
contributions.problem: The platform needed analytics instrumentation to track product activity and user interactions.
contributions.solution: Implemented Google Tag Manager functionality for tracking product-related events and verified the integration using the company's Google Analytics dashboard.
implementation: Worked with Google Tag Manager to integrate product activity tracking.
Implemented tracking relating to product views and sales activity.
Accessed Google Analytics to verify that the integration functioned.

contributions.name: Data Validation
contributions.summary: Worked with Zod schemas to validate application data as part of full-stack feature development.

workingMethods.dailyRoutine: Participated in daily standups to communicate progress, planned work and blockers.
workingMethods.developmentProcess: Worked independently on assigned features, from conceptualization and design through backend, database and frontend implementation.
workingMethods.collaboration: Discussed problems, implementation approaches and architectural decisions with the CTO and other developers. Features underwent testing and peer review before production deployment.
workingMethods.aiTools: Used Claude as a primary AI-assisted development tool, provided through the company.

collaborationAndInitiative.description: Proactively suggested closer collaboration and more opportunities for developers to work together on problems.
collaborationAndInitiative.actions: Reached out individually to the two more experienced developers and arranged a full working day with each to observe and discuss their development approaches.
collaborationAndInitiative.outcome: Both developers later expressed appreciation for the initiative.

collaborationAndInitiative.description: Identified opportunities to improve how new interns were introduced to the development team, particularly regarding guidance, collaboration and knowledge sharing.
collaborationAndInitiative.actions: Presented observations and suggestions to the CTO, who subsequently brought the subject to the full development team for discussion.
collaborationAndInitiative.outcome: The suggestions sparked a team-wide discussion. The internship ended before the new interns joined, so the eventual impact is unknown.

challenges: Adapting to a large unfamiliar codebase with limited previous professional experience.
Balancing significant technical ownership with the need for guidance and knowledge sharing.
Navigating the pace and expectations of a fully remote startup.
lessons: Developed experience taking responsibility for complete production features.
Learned to identify when independent problem-solving was appropriate and when technical discussion was valuable.
Recognized the importance of mentorship, collaboration and shared engineering knowledge.
Gained experience communicating concerns and proposing constructive improvements.
reflection.personalAssessment: The independence provided valuable practical experience but could also be overwhelming. The experience reinforced a strong appreciation for collaborative engineering environments.

outcomes: Implemented features that passed review and testing and were deployed to the production platform.
Gained first-hand experience working within a professional development team.
Received a positive recommendation from the CTO highlighting leadership qualities and eagerness to learn.
